items.html: And when she was sawed — that is, she took only half the mochin, namely Bina and Gevura (as mentioned elsewhere in the matter of the Shofar) — then her name of BaN was drawn to her, as is known, for the Bina and Gevura of ZA are BaN, as above. And then her Yesod and Malchut were completed, yet she was still lacking the illumination of the name MaH; and then the Achoraim of the external aspects of the pregnancy were given into her, and an inner aspect was made in her.
